ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.

18. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.

20. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

21. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

22. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
